name: vsharp
description: V# language support: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, completion, hover, go-to-definition and document symbols.

vsharp.server.path.description: Absolute path to the vsharp-lsp launcher. When empty the extension uses the copy bundled with it, and falls back to a 'vsharp-lsp' found on PATH.

vsharp.server.java.description: Absolute path to the java executable used to run the bundled server. When empty JAVA_HOME is used, then 'java' from PATH. V# requires Java 25 or later.

vsharp.trace.server.description: Log every LSP message to the V# output channel.

vsharp.allowUnboundedJoins.description: Match a build that passes --allow-unbounded-joins. Joining a task with Get/Join/GetNow waits outside the 60-second execution limit and is an error by default; enable this only when the build accepts it, so the editor does not report errors a passing build does not.
